recentItems.title: FULL: Bakit mabilis natapos? Korte idinetalye ang nangyari sa Day 23 ng VP impeach trial
recentItems.description:
Idinetalye ni Senate impeachment court spokesperson Atty. Reginald Tongol ang mga nangyari sa ika-23 araw ng impeachment trial ni Vice President Sara Duterte nitong Martes (Setyembre 8) kung saan inanunsyo ni counsel for prosecutors Atty. Lorna Kapunan na iaatras na nila ang lahat ng natitirang testigo para sa Articel 1 o ang 'di umano maling paggamit ng confidential funds.

Ito ay dahil ipatatawag na lamang daw ng prosekusyon si Duterte mismo upang tumestigo, hindi lamang sa Article 1 kundi sa lahat ng alegasyon sa articles of impeachment.

Tinanong ng midya si Tongol kung maaari bang pilitin ng korte ang bise na dumalo sa paglilitis. Narito ang kanyang sagot.

recentItems.title: Smoke billows from burning trucks on Yemen-Saudi border after claimed Houthi attack
recentItems.description:
A video released by Yemen's Houthis on Monday (September 7) showed smoke billowing from trucks near Al-Wadiah on the Yemen-Saudi borders after what the group said was an attack targeting trucks coming from Saudi Arabia.

   Reuters was able to verify the location with the buildings and roads that matched the archive and satellite imagery in the area. The date when the video was filmed was not verified. No old results were found posted online before September 7.

    There was no Saudi official confirmation of the trucks being targeted.

    On Tuesday (September 8), Houthi attacks disrupted Saudi energy facilities, authorities said.

    Operations at some energy facilities in Saudi Arabia, the world's top oil exporter, were halted on Tuesday following attacks by Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis that wounded that wounded 73 people, in what Saudi authorities described as a dangerous escalation.

    The Houthis attacked the southern cities of Abha, Khamis Mushait, Jazan and Najran, the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen said in an earlier statement, adding that the injured included women and children.

    The flare-up in violence between Saudi Arabia and the militant group came as tensions mounted between the United States and Iran as the wider Middle East conflict sent oil prices soaring with diplomatic negotiations stalling.

(Verification: Monica Naime, Nur-Azna Sanusi)

recentItems.title: Rason ng prosekusyon bakit inuna ang unexplained wealth sa impeach trial | ABS-CBN News
recentItems.description:
Courtesy of DZMM



Mas madami witnesses at mas madaming ebidensya. Ito ang rason ng prosekusyon kung bakit iuuna nila ang Article II sa impeachment trial ni VP Sara Duterte sa darating na linggo.

Ayon kay Atty. Benjamin Tolosa, House prosecution team spokesman, mayroon nang nakalap na 1,800 exhibits ang prosekusyon para sa unexplained wealth ni VP Sara.

Pag-uusapan pa ng prosekusyon kung kailangan pa ilabas ang kanilang mga testigo at ebidensya sa Article III ng impeachment.

recentItems.title: 'Queen'? How Kapunan described VP Sara instead of using 'mastermind,' 'sham'
recentItems.description:
In explaining why the prosecution panel dropped its remaining witnesses for the alleged misuse of confidential funds, counsel for the prosecutors Atty. Lorna Kapunan used the game of chess as a "metaphor" during Tuesday’s impeachment trial (September 8), calling the respondent Vice President Sara Duterte as the "Queen."

"The reason I make this metaphor, I am told that I cannot use the word sham, nor mastermind, nor can I use the words, illegal, improper, extravagant, immoral, unconscionable. I am not using these words, your Honor," Kapunan said.

recentItems.title: Kabataan nagrambol sa Tacurong; lalaki nawalan ng malay matapos bugbugin | ABS-CBN News
recentItems.description:
Huli sa video ang away ng mga kabataan nitong Lunes ng madaling araw sa isang inuman sa Poblacion sa Tacurong City, Sultan Kudarat. 

Napuruhan ang isang lalaki at nawalan ng malay.

Ayon sa nag-upload ng video, pinagtulungang suntukin ang lalaki matapos siyang iwan ng kaniyang mga kasama habang nagkakagulo.

Umawat sa insidente ang security guard at mga barangay tanod.

Ayon sa Tacurong City PNP, bigong arestuhin ang mga sangkot sa gulo dahil umalis at nagkaayos din umano ang magkabilang grupo.

Sa kabila nito, pupuntahan pa rin aniya ng mga pulis at barangay officials ang mga sangkot para sa ikinakasang imbestigasyon.
